compactEndpointAudit.bugSummary: 1) POST /brain/compact never updates SQLite threads.messages_json (remains 10 items). 2) /brain/compact creates note_item with role='developer' (brain.ts:1224), which /brain/turn (brain.ts:517) explicitly drops because it only accepts role==='user' || role==='assistant'!

sessionEndAudit.bugNote: Despite comment 'POST /brain/session-end — Session End & Memory Consolidation', brain.ts:1257-1295 only marks threads.mode='ended' and sessions.expires_at=0; it performs zero memory extraction or user_memory consolidation!
